join product p on o.prod_id = p.prod_id where o.status = 0

select o.client_id as clientId, p.prod_name as prodName, o.quantity as quantity, o.req_outbound_date as reqOutboundDate, o.outbound_process_date as outboundProcessDate, o.ware_id as wareId, o.status as status from outbound o join product p ON o.prod_id = p.prod_id

#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory i JOIN outbound o ON i.prod_id = o.prod_id AND i.client_id = o.client_id AND i.warehouse_pos_x = o.warehouse_pos_x AND i.warehouse_pos_y = o.warehouse_pos_y SET i.quantity = i.quantity - o.quantity ,i.last_outbound_date = now() WHERE o.outbound_id = #{outboundId}
UPDATE outbound SET status = 1, outbound_process_date = NOW() WHERE outbound_id = #{outboundId}

UPDATE userWareHouse uw JOIN outbound o ON uw.client_id = o.client_id AND uw.ware_id = o.ware_id AND uw.warehouse_pos_x = o.warehouse_pos_x AND uw.warehouse_pos_y = o.warehouse_pos_y JOIN product p ON o.prod_id = p.prod_id SET uw.warehouse_usage = uw.warehouse_usage - (o.quantity * p.prod_size) WHERE o.outbound_id = #{outboundId}
